name: 49426 · Hudsonville, MI
findings: ZIP 49426 (Hudsonville) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49426 (Hudsonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
